findings.title: Required audits of applications submitted by insurers for subsidy payments were not completed on a timely basis.
findings.description: Required audits of application information submitted by medical professional liability insurers that applied for and received subsidies from the Fund were not completed on a timely basis. As of February 2009, audits for subsidy years 2005 and 2006 were incomplete or delayed.
findings.recommendation: We again recommend that MIA complete audits of subsidy application information submitted by insurers on a timely basis, and take any appropriate follow-up action deemed necessary.

extraction.agency_response_summary: MIA agrees with the recommendation but states that State law does not specify annual audits or specific timeframes. They argue audits cannot be efficiently conducted until all activity for a subsidy year is complete and intend to continue following their policy.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date taken from transmittal letter. Finding 1 identified as repeated based on 'Status of Findings From Preceding Audit Report' section.
